notes.title: First update
notes.content:
First update for The Die Is Cast :

- English becomes the default language when the game is launched for the first time
- Survival dice are less frequent
- Inconsistencies in the story have been fixed
- The character sheet has been modified
- The problem of unlocking achievements has been fixed

Thank you for the welcome you gave to The Die Is Cast. Further fixes are to come.
